title: Teebox
subtitle: Building a multi-brand email production platform from the ground up.

evidence.statement: ~14 average emails per week across brands

quickView.problem: Email production depended on manual edits, repeated handoffs, QA, and developer availability.
quickView.evolution: Visual Helper → Section Builder → Multi-Brand → Email Management → QA + Translation → Dual ESP → API/MCP
quickView.product: A multi-brand email production and management system with Supabase handling the backend.
quickView.impact: Validated evidence includes ~14 average emails per week across brands and a 40% file-size reduction.
